decisions.reason: Superyacht crew recruitment draws directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer know-how, so the firm can read market feedback and refine the service at low risk.
The Smart Academy builds on the firm's training centres and has quickly grown to six partner institutions, which strengthens its knowledge base through cooperation with research and education bodies.
FuelEU monitoring services are close to the core technical management offer and met the regulatory deadline for all vessels, so the firm can clearly interpret and use this success.
The FuelEU dashboard is integrated into the firm's own PAL software and supported by in-house development, so it fits existing digital know-how and will improve with use.
The cost simulator complements the dashboard and the compliance services within PAL, builds on the firm's regulatory and software expertise, and meets client demand for planning FuelEU costs.
